cases.expected: schemas list remains empty after preloadJsonSchema() is called
cases.description: AnyOfValidator is instantiated with an empty internal schemas list. The preloadJsonSchema() method should invoke preloadJsonSchemas(emptyList) and, because the mocked BaseJsonValidator does not add any schemas, the list should stay empty. This verifies the method correctly forwards the empty list without altering it.

cases.expected: schemas list size becomes 3 after preloadJsonSchema() is called
cases.description: A test double of AnyOfValidator is created where the internal `schemas` list is pre‑filled with two mock JsonSchema instances. The overridden `preloadJsonSchemas(List<JsonSchema>)` method adds one additional mock schema to the supplied list. After invoking preloadJsonSchema(), the list should contain three schemas, confirming that the method forwards the existing list and that the delegate can modify it.

A subclass of AnyOfValidator overrides `preloadJsonSchemas` to throw a RuntimeException. When preloadJsonSchema() is executed, the exception should propagate to the caller. This test ensures that the method does not swallow exceptions from the delegated preload operation.

cases.expected: After first call, schemas list size is 2; after second call, size is 4 (each call adds two schemas).
cases.description: A test subclass of AnyOfValidator overrides preloadJsonSchemas to add exactly two mock JsonSchema instances to the supplied list. The test invokes preloadJsonSchema() twice and asserts that the internal list grows cumulatively, confirming that the method forwards the same mutable list on each call and does not reset it.

cases.expected: schemas list becomes empty after preloadJsonSchema() is called.
cases.description: A test double pre‑populates the internal schemas list with three mock schemas and overrides preloadJsonSchemas to invoke schemas.clear(). After calling preloadJsonSchema(), the list should be empty, verifying that the method correctly forwards the list even when the delegate clears it.

cases.expected: schemas list size increases by one and the newly added element is null.
cases.description: A subclass overrides preloadJsonSchemas to add a null entry to the supplied list. The test checks that the list contains a null element after preloadJsonSchema() execution, ensuring that the method does not guard against nulls added by the delegate.

group: Preload with large number of schemas

cases.expected: schemas list size becomes 100 after preloadJsonSchema() is called.
cases.description: The test subclass overrides preloadJsonSchemas to add 100 distinct mock JsonSchema objects to the list. This validates that preloadJsonSchema() can handle a large number of additions without side‑effects such as truncation or overflow.

cases.expected: schemas list size remains unchanged after preloadJsonSchema() is called.
cases.description: A subclass overrides preloadJsonSchemas with an empty implementation (does nothing). The internal list is pre‑filled with five mock schemas. After invoking preloadJsonSchema(), the list size should still be five, confirming that the method does not alter the list when the delegate makes no changes.

A subclass of AnyOfValidator sets the internal `schemas` field to null (e.g., via reflection) before invoking preloadJsonSchema(). Since the method dereferences `this.schemas`, a NullPointerException should be thrown.

A subclass replaces the internal `schemas` list with `Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>())`. When preloadJsonSchema() forwards this list to `preloadJsonSchemas`, any attempt to modify the list results in UnsupportedOperationException.
A subclass overrides `preloadJsonSchemas` to throw an IllegalArgumentException. The test verifies that this specific unchecked exception propagates unchanged to the caller.
